# smalljs

> Documentation for $mol — a reactive UI framework with typed views, automatic reactivity, and no virtual DOM. Each page below is available as raw Markdown at the linked URL.

## Getting Started

- [Introduction](https://b-on-g.github.io/smalljs/docs/introduction.md): What $mol is, who it is for, and a taste of reactive views.
- [Getting Started](https://b-on-g.github.io/smalljs/docs/getting-started.md): From an empty folder to a running, reactive $mol app in under 15 minutes.

## Essentials

- [Installation](https://b-on-g.github.io/smalljs/docs/installation.md): The MAM workspace, module layout, dev server, and production build.
- [Views](https://b-on-g.github.io/smalljs/docs/views.md): Declaring and composing components with the view.tree language.
- [State & Reactivity](https://b-on-g.github.io/smalljs/docs/state.md): Reactive properties, actions vs. computations, keyed and async state.
- [Routing](https://b-on-g.github.io/smalljs/docs/routing.md): The URL as reactive state: screens, links, and multiple parameters.

## Data

- [Data Fetching](https://b-on-g.github.io/smalljs/docs/data.md): Loading remote data with reactive async properties and loading states.
- [Giper Baza](https://b-on-g.github.io/smalljs/docs/giper-baza.md): Local-first data with automatic sync: entities, atoms, and CRUD.
